package.name: wamoduck_ros2
package.description:
ROS 2 nodes for the Wamoduck (wmduck) biped.
gait_player -- replay a reference gait CSV as sensor_msgs/JointState policy_node -- 50 Hz observation to ONNX to joint target (skeleton this stage) bridge_stub -- byte transport (/dev/ttyS1 or CAN) to ROS topics (skeleton + codec)
The node split follows docs/16 section 6.5 of the internal engineering tree: ROS lives only on the Linux side (no micro-ROS on the MCU), the wire protocol is the deterministic 46-byte-frame protocol, and the bridge is the only component that parses bytes. Plain rclpy, no real-time kernel. The names used there are wmduck_bridge / wmduck_policy / wmduck_safety; this package calls them bridge_stub / policy_node and has not written the safety node yet.
